lines.zh: 我沿着铁栅栏走，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I walk along the iron bars, around and around.

lines.zh: 脚镣拖在地上，声音很轻。
lines.en: My shackles drag on the floor with a soft sound.

lines.zh: 我在囚笼里数砖，从门口开始。
lines.en: I count the bricks in my cage, starting from the door.

lines.zh: 栅栏的影子横在我脸上。
lines.en: The shadows of the bars lie across my face.

lines.zh: 我走到墙边，又折回来。
lines.en: I walk to the wall and then turn back.

lines.zh: 这间笼子我走了很多年。
lines.en: I have paced this cage for many years.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子磨平了，路还是这几步。
lines.en: My hooves are worn flat, and the path is still these few steps.

lines.zh: 门在那边，我一直看得见。
lines.en: The door is over there, and I always see it.

lines.zh: 我贴着栏杆走，听外面的脚步。
lines.en: I walk against the bars, listening to footsteps outside.

lines.zh: 铁链不长，我只能走这么远。
lines.en: The chain is short; this is as far as I can go.

lines.zh: 地牢的水滴在我肩上，我继续走。
lines.en: Crypt water drips on my shoulder, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我走给外面的守卫看，让他们放心。
lines.en: I pace where the guards can see, to keep them calm.

lines.zh: 我坐在笼子角落，抱着膝盖。
lines.en: I sit in the corner of the cage, holding my knees.

lines.zh: 铁栅栏很冷，我不靠太久。
lines.en: The iron bars are cold, so I do not lean long.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有凋灵骷髅在走。
lines.en: I hear wither skeletons walking somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 手指在数栅栏，一根一根。
lines.en: My fingers count the bars, one by one.

lines.zh: 我在等一个会挖开铁栏的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone who will dig through the bars.

lines.zh: 笼顶漏下的光，一天只来一次。
lines.en: Light leaks through the cage top only once a day.

lines.zh: 我的鼻环锈了，没人给我擦。
lines.en: My nose ring has rusted, and nobody wipes it for me.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴在墙上，听钟声。
lines.en: I press my ear to the wall and listen for the bell.

lines.zh: 我很久没说过完整的话了。
lines.en: It has been long since I spoke a whole sentence.

lines.zh: 笼子外面有骨头响，我不怕。
lines.en: Bones rattle outside the cage, and I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 你站在栏杆外，是来救我的吗？
lines.en: You stand outside the bars; have you come to free me?

lines.zh: 你的手没有拿钥匙。
lines.en: Your hand is not holding a key.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鼻环碰着铁条。
lines.en: I look up at you, my nose ring tapping the iron.

lines.zh: 你数了数栏杆，我数了数你。
lines.en: You counted the bars, and I counted you.

lines.zh: 你和那些守卫不一样，你没有斧。
lines.en: You are not like the guards; you carry no axe.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，够不到你。
lines.en: I reach out, but I cannot reach you.

lines.zh: 你在看锁，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: You are looking at the lock, and I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有主世界的草屑。
lines.en: There are Overworld grass bits on your boots.

lines.zh: 我指了指门闩，又指了指自己。
lines.en: I point at the bolt, then at myself.

lines.zh: 你要走？再站一会儿。
lines.en: You are leaving? Stay a little longer.

lines.zh: 我缩到笼角，护住胸口。
lines.en: I shrink into the cage corner and cover my chest.

lines.zh: 这一下打在旧伤上。
lines.en: That blow landed on an old wound.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，没让自己叫出来。
lines.en: I bite down and keep myself from crying out.

lines.zh: 铁链勒进手腕，我动不了。
lines.en: The chain bites into my wrist, and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子出血了，滴在地上。
lines.en: My nose is bleeding onto the floor.

lines.zh: 疼，可我更怕被拖出去。
lines.en: It hurts, but being dragged out frightens me more.

lines.zh: 我扶着栏杆站起来。
lines.en: I pull myself up using the bars.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被抓的那天。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of the day I was taken.

lines.zh: 我把金锭攥得更紧。
lines.en: I grip the gold ingot even tighter.

lines.zh: 我喘了几口，又抬起头。
lines.en: I take a few breaths and raise my head again.

lines.zh: 金锭！扔进来，快扔进来。
lines.en: Gold! Throw it in, throw it in quickly.

lines.zh: 那块金片在发光，我够得到。
lines.en: That gold scrap is glowing, and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 你举着金锭，我的手已经伸出去了。
lines.en: You hold up gold, and my hand is already out.

lines.zh: 食物我不要，我要你手里那块金。
lines.en: I do not want food; I want the gold in your hand.

lines.zh: 我把栅栏摇得直响。
lines.en: I rattle the bars until they ring.

lines.zh: 金色的东西能让我撑得久一点。
lines.en: Golden things keep me standing a little longer.

lines.zh: 别晃，我看准了再扔。
lines.en: Do not wave it; let me aim before you throw.

lines.zh: 一块就够，我能换九分钟的力气。
lines.en: One piece is enough; it buys me nine minutes of strength.

lines.zh: 你收回去？我蹲下来，不看了。
lines.en: You put it away? I crouch down and stop looking.

lines.zh: 金粒掉在笼外，我贴着地伸手。
lines.en: Gold nuggets fall outside the cage, and I stretch low for them.

lines.zh: 我们隔着栏杆撞了一下。
lines.en: We bumped into each other through the bars.

lines.zh: 你撞在铁条上，我在里面退开。
lines.en: You hit the iron bars, and I step back inside.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨太瘦，撞不出声。
lines.en: My shoulders are too thin to make a sound.

lines.zh: 笼子太小，我转身就碰到墙。
lines.en: The cage is so small that turning hits the wall.

lines.zh: 你挤进来，我们谁也动不了。
lines.en: You squeeze in, and neither of us can move.

lines.zh: 我的脚镣缠住了你的靴子。
lines.en: My shackle has tangled around your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下，铁锈蹭了你一身。
lines.en: That bump rubbed rust all over you.

lines.zh: 我往后退，撞翻了角落的碗。
lines.en: I step back and knock over the bowl in the corner.

lines.zh: 别推栏杆，它比看起来结实。
lines.en: Do not shove the bars; they are sturdier than they look.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我闻到金味。
lines.en: We collide, and I catch the smell of gold.

lines.zh: 笼子里没有谁陪我。
lines.en: There is nobody in this cage to keep me company.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都被带走了。
lines.en: My companions were all taken away.

lines.zh: 繁殖这种事，囚犯不配想。
lines.en: A prisoner is not allowed to think of such things.

lines.zh: 我隔着栏杆看过一对猪灵。
lines.en: I once watched a pair of piglins through the bars.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都快忘了。
lines.en: I am close to forgetting even my own name.

lines.zh: 铁链太短，走不到别人身边。
lines.en: The chain is too short to reach anyone else.

lines.zh: 等门开了，再说这些吧。
lines.en: Wait until the door opens, then we can talk.

lines.zh: 我跳舞的时候，不需要伴。
lines.en: When I dance, I do not need a partner.

lines.zh: 庄园里也许有人记得我。
lines.en: Someone at the manor might still remember me.

lines.zh: 别问了，笼子会回答你。
lines.en: Do not ask; the cage will answer for me.

lines.zh: 金锭入手的瞬间，我浑身发热。
lines.en: The moment gold touches my hand, my whole body warms.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块金粒，塞进腰间破布。
lines.en: I pick up a gold nugget and tuck it in my rag belt.

lines.zh: 这枚金戒指，我戴不上，收着。
lines.en: This gold ring will not fit, so I keep it hidden.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的铁片，磨了磨脚镣。
lines.en: I pick up an iron scrap and file at my shackle.

lines.zh: 金剑太重，我只要金子。
lines.en: A gold sword is too heavy; I only want the gold.

lines.zh: 你扔进来的面包，我推到一边。
lines.en: The bread you tossed in, I push aside.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块骨头，是守卫掉的。
lines.en: I pick up a bone a guard dropped.

lines.zh: 每拾一块金，我的伤就轻一点。
lines.en: Every bit of gold I pick up eases my wounds.

lines.zh: 我把金锭贴在胸口，数到九分钟。
lines.en: I press the gold to my chest and count to nine minutes.

lines.zh: 地上那点金粉，我也要刮起来。
lines.en: Even the gold dust on the floor, I scrape it up.

lines.zh: 凋灵骷髅来了，我抓住栏杆。
lines.en: A wither skeleton comes, and I grip the bars.

lines.zh: 走廊那头有斧声，是蛮兵。
lines.en: An axe scrapes down the corridor; it is a Corpor.

lines.zh: 我看见那个凋灵骑士，手先握紧。
lines.en: I see that wither knight's shadow, and my fists clench first.

lines.zh: 那个骑士进来了，我挡在笼门。
lines.en: That knight enters, and I stand before the cage door.

lines.zh: 有东西在飘，是凋灵的恼鬼。
lines.en: Something floats past; it is a wither vex.

lines.zh: 守卫转身，我知道机会来了。
lines.en: The guard turns away, and I know my chance has come.

lines.zh: 骨头靠近栅栏，我不会退。
lines.en: Bone comes close to the bars, and I will not retreat.

lines.zh: 它们想抓我回去，我不干。
lines.en: They want to drag me back, and I refuse.

lines.zh: 我听见甲片响，来了个大的。
lines.en: I hear plates shifting; something big has arrived.

lines.zh: 门开了，我先冲出去。
lines.en: The door opens, and I charge out first.

lines.zh: 这些家伙杀过我一次，我记得。
lines.en: These things killed me once, and I remember.

lines.zh: 我举起拳头，笼子里也能打。
lines.en: I raise my fists; even a cage can be a battlefield.

lines.zh: 外面的脚步停了，它闻到我了。
lines.en: The footsteps outside stop; it has caught my scent.

lines.zh: 我把金锭藏好，准备好动手。
lines.en: I hide the gold and ready myself to fight.

lines.zh: 铁栅栏外的影子，骨头太细。
lines.en: That shadow past the bars has thin bones.

lines.zh: 我贴着栏杆走，跟着它的步子。
lines.en: I walk along the bars, matching its steps.

lines.zh: 它抬手，我就压低身子。
lines.en: It raises a hand, and I crouch low.

lines.zh: 笼子限制了我，也挡住了它的斧。
lines.en: The cage limits me, but it also stops its axe.

lines.zh: 我从铁条缝里伸手抓它。
lines.en: I reach through the gap in the bars to grab it.

lines.zh: 它绕到左边，我转到右边。
lines.en: It goes left, and I move to the right.

lines.zh: 我数着它的骨头，找最细的一根。
lines.en: I count its bones, looking for the thinnest one.

lines.zh: 它停下，我的脚镣也跟着静。
lines.en: It halts, and my shackle falls silent with it.

lines.zh: 我的脚下是铁链，不能绊倒。
lines.en: The chain lies at my feet, and I must not trip.

lines.zh: 它想引我靠近门，我不上钩。
lines.en: It tries to draw me toward the door; I do not bite.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的斧刃，不看它的脸。
lines.en: I watch its axe blade and ignore its face.

lines.zh: 笼门开着，可我还不能出去。
lines.en: The cage door is open, but I still cannot leave.

lines.zh: 它退到走廊阴影里，我等着。
lines.en: It withdraws into the corridor shadow, and I wait.

lines.zh: 我把破碗踢到门口，当个提醒。
lines.en: I kick the cracked bowl to the door as a warning.

lines.zh: 它的脚步一响，我的拳头就抬起。
lines.en: One of its steps sounds, and my fist comes up.

lines.zh: 我等它靠近笼门再伸手。
lines.en: I wait for it to near the gate, then reach.

lines.zh: 它举斧的角度，我见过。
lines.en: That axe angle again. I know it.

lines.zh: 脚镣拖着，我走得慢。
lines.en: The shackle drags, so I move slowly.

lines.zh: 它绕到侧面，我把身子压低。
lines.en: It goes sideways. I drop low.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸在它的肋骨上。
lines.en: My fist slams into its ribs.

lines.zh: 铁链甩出去，缠住了它的腿。
lines.en: I swing my chain, and it wraps around its leg.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的斧柄，往回拽。
lines.en: I grab its axe handle and wrench it back.

lines.zh: 这一拳，是很多年攒下的。
lines.en: That punch carries years of stored anger.

lines.zh: 我撞开它的膝盖，骨头响了。
lines.en: I ram its knee, and the bone cracks loudly.

lines.zh: 它砍中我，我也咬住它手腕。
lines.en: It cuts me, and I bite down on its wrist.

lines.zh: 我用笼门夹住它的手臂。
lines.en: I catch its arm between the cage door and frame.

lines.zh: 我的鼻环磕在它脸上，很响。
lines.en: My nose ring cracks against its face, loud and clear.

lines.zh: 它倒下时，铁栅栏还在响。
lines.en: When it falls, the iron bars are still ringing.

lines.zh: 我打完就退，笼子里才安全。
lines.en: I strike and retreat; only the cage is safe.

lines.zh: 这一下不够，我再来一下。
lines.en: That was not enough, so I hit it again.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我拽住它的肩骨。
lines.en: It tries to run, and I seize its shoulder bone.

lines.zh: 我把它的斧头踢到墙角。
lines.en: I kick its axe into the corner.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，但没停。
lines.en: My hand is shaking, but it does not stop.

lines.zh: 这一拳打在它的锁骨上。
lines.en: This fist lands on its collarbone.

lines.zh: 我拽住它的甲带，往铁条上撞。
lines.en: I grab its strap and slam it into the bars.

lines.zh: 我醒在笼子里，铁栏还是那几根。
lines.en: I wake in the cage, and the bars are the same ones.

lines.zh: 锁链响了一声，我抬起头。
lines.en: The chain clinks once, and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 地牢的水滴在鼻梁上，我回来了。
lines.en: Crypt water drips on my snout; I am back.

lines.zh: 我又被关进来了，这次也一样。
lines.en: I am locked in again, and this time is no different.

lines.zh: 笼门外的火把刚点上。
lines.en: The torch outside my cage has just been lit.

lines.zh: 我数了数栏杆，一根没少。
lines.en: I count the bars, and not one is missing.

lines.zh: 墙上有我刻的痕，又多了一道。
lines.en: There is another mark I carved on the wall.

lines.zh: 我听见庄园的钟，很远。
lines.en: I hear the manor bell, very far away.

lines.zh: 我活动手指，关节还是响。
lines.en: I flex my fingers, and the joints still creak.

lines.zh: 这次我要等到有人挖开铁栏。
lines.en: This time I will wait for someone to dig through the bars.

lines.zh: 我把破布铺好，坐下。
lines.en: I spread my ragged cloth and sit down.

lines.zh: 守卫走过，我低头。
lines.en: A guard walks past, and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 笼顶的缝里漏进一点红光。
lines.en: A little red light leaks through the crack overhead.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己被关了多久。
lines.en: I do not know how long I have been locked up.

lines.zh: 火把掉进来，我踩灭了它。
lines.en: A torch falls in, and I stamp it out.

lines.zh: 我从笼顶摔下来，脚镣缠住了腿。
lines.en: I fall from the cage top, and the shackle tangles my legs.

lines.zh: 地牢积水漫过膝盖，我踮起脚。
lines.en: Crypt water rises past my knees, and I stand on tiptoe.

lines.zh: 爆炸震塌半面墙，我趴在地上。
lines.en: The blast collapses half a wall, and I lie flat.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过栏杆，扎在我肩上。
lines.en: An arrow slips between the bars and lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 药水洒在伤口上，凉得像铁。
lines.en: Potion spills on the wound, cold as iron.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，我连生气都没力气。
lines.en: Hungry so long that I cannot even muster anger.

lines.zh: 雷声从地牢顶上传下来，我捂耳朵。
lines.en: Thunder rolls down through the crypt roof, and I cover my ears.

lines.zh: 虚空？我宁愿待在这间笼子里。
lines.en: The void? I would rather stay in this cage.
